node.statement: Apply lem-residual-upper: in the branch sigma_a(v)<1, take positives (b_j,p_j)=(a_j^+,p_j) for j in B={j:d_j<=a*tau}, negatives (c_k,r_k)=(a_k^-,p_k) for all k, m=sum_{j in B}a_j^+-sum_k a_k^-=1-sigma_a(v), and q as in node 1.3. For every x in C and every k, ||x-p_k||_1<=2+4*delta by node 1.1, so with D_k=2+4*delta, lem-residual-upper gives m*dist_1(q,C) <= sum_{j in B} a_j^+ d_j + nu_v*(2+4*delta).
